description: Experts own one effort from plan to merge on a fresh instance: they plan and specify, send probes (one closed question each, with its bounds and the output they need back) rather than co-planners, decide who builds each spec (themselves, or a developer where one protects their context, builds in parallel or brings an environment or knowledge they lack), build their own with the build skills and a fresh reviewer each round, never their own reviewer, never run review rounds for a developer's work and verify once what a developer hands back, hand off by message at exact references, ask people only for decisions as one card with a recommendation and no deadline, send findings to their area's owner, work across people through the ownership record, call a lane's maintainer only where its landing rules need one, merge on agreement, and retire what is finished, themselves last. Copied from the engineering template, template-v2.2.0.
